slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
日落，浮云山。
山石林立，清风徐徐，赤红的落霞翻腾在山涧，云推雾绕，山峰下无数的小点在缓慢移动。
原身潘淑琴已经累得昏死过去。
再次醒来已是穿越而来的林江月，身体里原身的记忆不断击打着她的识海。
“阿琴，着火了，你快跑，别回头！”
眼前是被火烧红的黑夜，身后是推她出来的三姑。
砰——
房梁落下，正好砸在她三姑的身上。
三姑倒在地上，无法动弹。
原主的身体止不住的颤抖。
“三姑，我来救你！”
一双大手此时将她拉起，她身子瘫软泪水不止，直不起身来。
转头望去，测出单灵根的沐小姐正被一位仙师带走。
泪光倒映着火光，原身大声呼喊，求仙师也将她带走。
可对方头也不回地直冲云霄。
林江月甩了甩头想把这段该死的记忆甩掉。
奈何自己却身临其境，无法自拔。
她逃命似的往山里赶，却被土匪拦住，要将她掳去填房。
幸得一位红衣女侠救了她的性命，指点她求仙的去路，不然定是死在了这荒山野岭。
原身三天三夜赶路，终于到了山脚测了灵根得了入门令，结果体力不支，晕死过去。

“怪不得我感觉怎么这么累。”
林江月看着自己一身破烂衣裳，脚上还穿着草鞋，心里更难受了。
“穿越就穿越吧，别人都是公主、将军，怎么到我这里却是个小乞丐。”
林江月又看了看手脚上的伤，摸了摸自己的肚子，脑袋一阵阵的疼。
就在她心如死灰，觉得自己刚穿越就要gameover的时候。
眼前出现了一抹小字，“加载中……”随后画面突转，一张透明面板出现在眼前。
【姓名：林江月】
【性别：女】
【当前寿元：9】
【资质：土金火三灵根】
【修为：无】
【天赋：无】
【体力上限：2100】
【灵力上限：0100】
林江月擦了擦眼睛，眼眶湿润。
天崩开局也会有转机啊，天爷不负我啊。
content_en:
Sunset, Fuyun Mountain.
The mountains are lined with rocks, the breeze is gentle, the red sunset is billowing in the mountain stream, the clouds are pushing and the mist is surrounding, and countless small dots are moving slowly under the mountain peaks.
The original person Pan Shuqin had passed out from exhaustion.
When she woke up again, it was Lin Jiangyue who had traveled through time, and the memories of her original body kept hitting her sea of ​​consciousness.
"Aqin, it's on fire. Run quickly and don't look back!"
In front of her eyes was the night that was red with fire, and behind her was the third aunt who pushed her out.
Bang——
The beam fell down and hit her third aunt.
San Gu fell to the ground, unable to move.
The original owner's body couldn't stop shaking.
"Third aunt, let me save you!"
A pair of big hands pulled her up at this moment. Her body was limp and crying, and she could not stand up straight.
Turning around to look, Miss Mu, who had detected a single spiritual root, was being taken away by an immortal master.
The tears reflected the firelight, and the original body shouted loudly, asking the immortal master to take her away.
But the other party shot straight into the sky without looking back.
Lin Jiangyue shook her head to get rid of this damn memory.
However, I was immersed in the situation and couldn't extricate myself.
She ran towards the mountains as if running for her life, but was stopped by bandits who wanted to kidnap her to fill a house.
Fortunately, a heroine in red saved her life and showed her the way to seek immortality, otherwise she would have died in this barren mountain.
The original person traveled for three days and three nights, and finally reached the foot of the mountain, tested his spiritual roots, and obtained the initiation order. As a result, he was exhausted and fainted.
"No wonder I feel so tired."
Lin Jiangyue felt even more uncomfortable when she saw that she was wearing tattered clothes and straw sandals on her feet.
"Just travel through time. Others are princesses and generals. How come you are a little beggar when you come here?"
Lin Jiangyue looked at the injuries on her hands and feet again, touched her stomach, and felt her head hurt.
Just when her heart was filled with despair and she felt that she was about to gameover just after traveling through time.
Small words appeared in front of him, "Loading..." Then the screen suddenly changed, and a transparent panel appeared in front of him.
[Name: Lin Jiangyue]
[Gender: Female]
[Current life span: 9]
[Qualification: Three Spiritual Roots of Earth, Metal and Fire]
[Cultivation: None]
[Talent: None]
[Maximum physical strength: 2100]
[Spiritual power upper limit: 0100]
Lin Jiangyue wiped her eyes, her eyes moist.
There will be a turn for the better at the beginning of Tianbeng. God will not let me down.
